bench|cycling.name: 20-Min All-Out FTP Benchmark TT
bench|cycling.notes: Pace evenly for 20 minutes at maximum sustainable effort.

bench|running.name: 20-Min Threshold Pace Benchmark Run
bench|running.notes: Sustain maximum hard pace for 20 minutes to establish threshold pace.

mobility|bogus.name: Cat-Cow
mobility|bogus.notes: Slowly arch and round the spine with the breath.

mobility|bogus.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
mobility|bogus.notes: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side slowly; pause at each end.

mobility|bogus.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 60 s each side. Squeeze the back glute, tuck the pelvis, reach the arm up.

mobility|bogus.name: Open Book Rotation
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. Side-lying, knees bent; rotate the top arm open and follow it with your eyes.

mobility|bogus.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. Strap or towel round the foot, leg straight, pull gently.

mobility|bogus.name: Wall Slides
mobility|bogus.notes: Back and forearms on the wall; slide up without the ribs flaring.

mobility|bogus.name: Pigeon Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 60 s each side. Front shin across the body, hips square; fold forward to deepen.

mobility|bogus.name: Couch Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 60 s each side. Back knee at the wall, shin up the wall; stay upright.

mobility|bogus.name: Thread the Needle
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. On all fours, reach one arm under the body, then open it to the ceiling.

mobility|bogus.name: Hamstring Floss
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. Half-kneeling, straighten and bend the front leg for 10 slow reps.

mobility|bogus.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. Forearm on the door frame at shoulder height, step through.

mobility|bogus.name: Deep Squat Hold
mobility|bogus.notes: Heels down, elbows push the knees out, chest up.

mobility|bogus.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
mobility|bogus.notes: Roller across the upper back, hands behind the head, extend over it.

mobility|bogus.name: Sleeper Stretch
mobility|bogus.notes: 45 s each side. Lie on your side, arm at 90°; gently press the forearm down.

mobility|bogus.name: Child's Pose Breathing
mobility|bogus.notes: Long breaths out through the mouth to switch off.

strength|bogus.name: Warm-up
strength|bogus.notes: 2 rounds: 10 bodyweight squats, 5 walking lunges each leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 band pull-aparts or arm circles. Then 1-2 light sets of the first lift.

strength|bogus.name: A. Tempo Bodyweight Squat
strength|bogus.notes: 3 × 8. 3 s down, 1 s pause at the bottom, stand up tall. Rest 2 min between sets. Challenging weight: finish each set with 2-3 reps left in the tank.

strength|bogus.name: B1. Push-Up
strength|bogus.notes: 3 × 8. Body in one straight line; hands on a bench makes it easier, feet on it harder. Superset with Inverted Row: alternate sets, rest 2 min after each pair. Challenging weight: finish each set with 2-3 reps left in the tank.

strength|bogus.name: B2. Inverted Row
strength|bogus.notes: 3 × 8. Under a sturdy table or low bar, body straight; pull the chest to it. Superset with Push-Up: alternate sets, rest 2 min after each pair. Challenging weight: finish each set with 2-3 reps left in the tank.

strength|bogus.name: C. Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
strength|bogus.notes: 3 × 8 each side. Reach the free leg back with hips square; touch a wall for balance if needed. Rest 2 min between sets. Challenging weight: finish each set with 2-3 reps left in the tank.

strength|bogus.name: D1. Front Plank
strength|bogus.notes: 2 × 40 s hold. Squeeze the glutes and brace; don't let the hips sag. Rest 45 s.

strength|bogus.name: Cool-down Stretches
strength|bogus.notes: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch 30 s each side, standing hamstring stretch 30 s each side, doorway chest stretch 30 s.
